name: PT PLN (Persero)
description: Indonesia's state-owned electric utility: generation, transmission and distribution across the national grid, and the state counterparty for utility-scale power projects. Partner (with Masdar) in the Cirata floating solar PV plant in West Java — 145 MW at its 2023 commissioning, the largest in Southeast Asia, with a planned expansion to 500 MW.
products: National grid generation, transmission and distribution (Java-Madura-Bali, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi systems)
Utility-scale renewable offtake and partnerships (Cirata 145 MW floating PV with Masdar)
